Les données utilisées par PokeStream et: How PokeStream uses your data and how you can manage it.
Ton identifiant, ton pseudo et ton e-mai: Your ID, display name and email are used to manage your account. Your overlays, themes, compositions and uploaded images are saved so you can access and use them.
Tes créations restent enregistrées tant: Your creations remain saved until you delete them, including after a subscription ends. Our service providers process the data needed for sign-in, hosting and storage to operate the service.
Toute personne qui possède ton lien OBS: Anyone with your OBS link can display its content: team, badges, counter and composition elements. The link does not allow editing your creations. You can renew it or disable broadcasting in the relevant tool.
Connect envoie les données de partie néc: Connect sends the game data needed for the overlay: team, HP, badges and Nuzlocke counter. No ROM or save file is uploaded. The application’s preferences and Nuzlocke journal stay on your PC.
Tu peux retirer un appareil depuis la pa: You can remove a device from the Connect page. The last synced team remains available in your Studio profile.
Patreon gère les abonnements et les paie: Patreon manages subscriptions and payments. If you link your account, PokeStream stores your Patreon ID, subscription status and the authorization needed to verify your access. We do not receive your banking details.
Dissocier Patreon supprime la liaison et: Unlinking Patreon removes the connection and its authorization. It does not cancel your subscription, which you manage directly on Patreon.
Les illustrations peuvent être chargées: Artwork may load from external services. These services receive the connection information needed to display the images, including your IP address.
Tu peux modifier ton pseudo depuis ton p: You can edit your display name from your profile, export or delete overlays in Studio, and delete themes or compositions in their respective tools. An image removed from a composition is deleted after saving if no other composition uses it.
Pour une question ou une demande d’accès: For questions or requests to access, correct or delete your data, contact JOYKIX, who operates PokeStream.
Les cookies conservent ta session et ton: Cookies keep you signed in and remember your language. The demo, some drafts and preferences stay in your browser. No advertising or audience analytics tools are integrated.
